newsitem.title: GERMANY: New Zealand to recall Iran envoy, Bonn says.
newsitem.headline: New Zealand to recall Iran envoy, Bonn says.

text.p: New Zealand has joined other Western countries by recalling its ambassador from Iran in reaction to a German court verdict that Iran ordered the murder of four dissidents, Bonn said on Friday.
The German Foreign Ministry said New Zealand Foreign Minister Don McKinnon had agreed to the measure during a meeting in Bonn with his German counterpart Klaus Kinkel.
McKinnon had decided to recall the New Zealand ambassador to Tehran for consultations "out of solidarity with Germany", the ministry said in a statement.

Most European Union states have confirmed they are recalling their ambassadors and Australia said on Friday it would do the same. The EU has also broken off its policy of pursuing a "critical dialogue" with Iran.
